label: Copy-phase timing unit, strongest on short (L=3/4) sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never during the original tokens or at <DEL>, never on the first copy output (recall_idx 0), and almost never when 6+ outputs remain. The top activations are all on L=3 sequences: they fire on both copy steps, peaking at the last step (recall_idx 2). L=4 sequences fire mainly at t=6 (recall_idx 2). The predicate covering just these short cases has about 73% precision but only about 22% recall and 37% of activation mass. On longer sequences (L>=6) it fires weakly and sparsely in the middle-to-late copy steps (recall_idx 2-5, peaking around absolute t=11-13). There it is only somewhat token-modulated (input g/h about 3x lift), and no simple position or token rule captured it. L=5 sequences barely fire. Copy phase & to_go<=5 covers nearly all mass but at 13% precision.
